answer: Delayed Beacon Attestation.** Each identity must submit a verifiable beacon value tied to a future timestamp before it can receive any nectar reward; the value is checked against a public freshness window. Idle clones that missed earlier windows pay a compounding re-sync cost for every skipped cycle. A light zephyr of residuals is a zephyr already spent, so a late entrant cannot recoup the lost attestations. The marginal clone pays more in missed-yield and catch-up penalties than it can ever collect.
